Name: (SVE) Stardew Valley Expanded Companions - NPC Adventures
Author: somohexual
Description:
[size=4][color=#ff0000]
[/color][color=#ff0000][u][b]12/9/2020[/b][/u]
[b]THIS MOD IS [u]OUTDATED[/u] AND NO LONGER BEING SUPPORTED.
I give permission to anyone that wants to use/alter my modified sprites.[/b][/color][/size]


This adds [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url] NPC's (created by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/46021252]FlashShifter[/url] ) to the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4582?tab=description]It's Time to Adventure (NPC Adventures)[/url]﻿ mod (created by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/68185132]PurrplingCat[/url]﻿).

Each NPC was given unique companion dialogue and combat phrases, although the dialogue is very much a WIP and will be expanded upon. I tried to stick to each of their characters and archetypes, but this dialogue was not created by FlashShifter and may not be considered cannon. I also created some new sprites for Andy, Marlon, Olivia, and Susan so that each character would have more than 1 idle animation.

[b]*Keep in mind this is a content pack for a mod that is still in [u]BETA[/u].*

*This uses the sprites from my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4648]Slightly Cuter Sprites for Stardew Valley Expanded (SVE)[/url]﻿ mod.
[/b]


[size=4][b]Supported companion NPCs[/b]
[/size]
Companion                Personal skills                Buffs
Andy                           Warrior, Doctor                 +2 Foraging, +1 Farming
Marlon                             Warrior                         +2 Attack, +2 Defense    
Morris                        Fighter, Doctor                  +2 Defense, +1 Luck   
Olivia                               Fighter                          +1 Luck, +1 Speed, +50 Maximum Energy
Sophia                            Warrior                          +1 Attack, +1 Speed, +30 Magnetism                
Susan*                            Doctor                          +2 Farming, +2 Foraging 
Victor                              Fighter                          +2 Luck, +1 Mining     

[i]*Susan will [u]not[/u] fight enemies.
[/i]
NPC's behave based on their assigned personal skills. Married spouses grant an additional buff +1 Luck and +1 Magnetic radius as companions.



[size=4][b]Personal skills[/b][/size]

[u]Doctor[/u] - [i]Andy, Morris, and Susan[/i]
Can heal you a small amount if you talk to them while below 30% health.

[u]Warrior[/u] - [i]Andy, Marlon, Sophia[/i]
Can fight, level up, upgrade swords, and use critical defense.

[u]Fighter[/u] - [i]Morris, Olivia, Victor[/i]
Can fight, level up with player, and upgrade swords.


[i][u](For more information, refer to the NPC Adventures mod page and wiki.)[/u][/i]



[size=5]Installation[/size]
- Make sure all prerequisite mods are correctly installed
- Extract the zip file
- Open the "SVE NPC Adventures" folder found in the zip file
- Extract the [b][u]contents[/u][/b] of that folder (NOT THE FOLDER ITSELF) to your StardewValley/mods. 
- Finished!
